عند اختبار النظام أو عمل نظام الأطفاء الذاتى للوحدة الغازية

يتكون نظام الاطفاء الذاتى بغاز 
شركة2 من عدد من الاسطوانات يوجد بداخلها غاز ثانى اكسيد 
 الكربون فى حالته السائلة تحت ضغط 80 بار تقريبا كما يتم وضع هذه الاسطوانات فى 
 مجموعات طبقا لكمية الغاز المطلوبة للاطفاء وتكون كل مجموعة من هذه المجموعات 
 مخصصة لاطفاء الحريق فى منطقة محددة تتناسب مع حجم الغاز داخل هذه الاسطوانات 
 ويوجد رشاشات لغاز الاطفاء ومكتشفات لهب موزعة كما بالجدول التالى:-

وكل من مكتشفات اللهب 
والحرارة لها خطين غير معتمدين على بعضهما ولكى يعمل نظام الحريق لا بد ان تاتى 
اشارة انذار بوجود حريق من احد مكتشفات الحريق على الخط الاول 
مقترنة بانذار على 
احد مكتشفات الحريق على الخط الثانى فان سولونيد تحرير الاوزان يتحرق فيعمل نظام 
الحريق وفى نفس الوقت تذهب اشارة الخروج الاضطرارى 
Trip من مفتاح
limit switch الى مختلف مكونات الوحدة لكى تتوقف ويعمل 
نظام الحركة البطيئة 
وفى حالة اشتغال نظام الاطفاء الذاتى يحدث تفريغ للاسطوانات وفى هذه الحالة يتم 
استبدالها

وضع الاسطوانة عند حامل الاسطوانات 
 عند موضع تركيبها

فك غطاء الحماية 
 A ووضعة فى مكان 
 آمن لحين اعادة استخدامة 
 مع ملاحظة عدم جذب تيلة الامان لبلف الاسطوانة

ربط اذرع التعليق 
 B فى رأس الاسطوانة

وضع رافعة الاسطوانات 
 C اسفل الاسطوانة ورفع الاسطوانة لأعلى حتى 
 يمكن تثبيت اذرع التعليق B فى جهاز 
 الوزن D الحامل للاسطوانة مع التأكد 
 من ان الاسطوانة تم تركيبها فى وضع اتجاه الفتح الصحيح للبلف 
 حيث ان بلف الاسطوانة له اتجاه معين للفتح

رفع السدادة من على فتحة بلف الاسطوانة وتركيب خرطوم الضغط 
 العالى 
 E فى بلف الاسطوانة مع ملاحظة وضع جوان من 
 الجرنجريت لاحكام الربط

rows: Equipment: Automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system for the Siemens VZ2 gas unit, Preussag – Minimax
Issued to: Damietta Combined Cycle Power Station
Procedure: Replacing CO2 cylinders when the system is tested or when the automatic fire extinguishing system operates

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for replacing the CO2 cylinders when the system is tested or when the automatic fire extinguishing system of the gas unit operates.

The automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system consists of a number of cylinders containing carbon dioxide gas in its liquid state under a pressure of approximately 80 bar. The cylinders are arranged in groups according to the quantity of gas required for extinguishing, and each group is dedicated to extinguishing a fire in a specific area matching the volume of gas inside these cylinders. There are extinguishing gas nozzles and flame detectors distributed as shown in the following table:

Each of the flame and heat detectors has two independent lines, and for the fire system to operate a fire alarm signal must come from one of the fire detectors on the first line together with an alarm from one of the fire detectors on the second line. The weight-release solenoid then moves, the fire system operates, and at the same time the emergency trip signal goes from the limit switch to the various components of the unit so that they stop, and the slow-motion (turning gear) system operates. When the automatic fire extinguishing system operates, the cylinders are discharged, in which case they are replaced.

This document was prepared by Eng. Yousry Abdel Halim Abdel Latif, tested by Eng. Wasfy William Nashed – Senior Engineer, Occupational Safety and Health Department – and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed El-Lawandy, General Manager. It was reviewed by Chemist Ahmed El-Sayed Ibrahim and Eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman, General Manager of Quality Assurance and Quality Control, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anan – Head of Damietta Power Station Sector – and Eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa, Head of Quality Assurance and Quality Control Sector, East Delta Electricity Production Company.

rows: Place the cylinder on the cylinder holder at its installation position
Remove protective cover A and place it in a safe place until it is reused, taking care not to pull the safety pin of the cylinder valve
Connect suspension arms B to the cylinder head

Place the cylinder hoist C under the cylinder and raise the cylinder until suspension arms B can be fixed to the weighing device D carrying the cylinder, making sure that the cylinder is installed in the correct valve-opening direction, as the cylinder valve has a specific opening direction
Remove the plug from the cylinder valve opening and fit the high-pressure hose E to the cylinder valve, taking care to fit a Klingerit gasket to ensure a tight connection

Maintenance Procedures Information System

Document No.: FS-043-R0A | Equipment: Automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system for the Siemens VZ2 gas unit, Preussag – Minimax
Issued to: Damietta Combined Cycle Power Station
Document status: Approved
Date of document approval: 27 May 2008 | Procedure: Replacing CO2 cylinders when the system is tested or when the automatic fire extinguishing system operates
Date of next review: May 2013
Introduction
This document sets out the steps for replacing the CO2 cylinders when the system is tested or when the automatic fire extinguishing system of the gas unit operates.
The automatic CO2 gas fire extinguishing system consists of a number of cylinders containing carbon dioxide gas in its liquid state under a pressure of approximately 80 bar. The cylinders are arranged in groups according to the quantity of gas required for extinguishing, and each group is dedicated to extinguishing a fire in a specific area matching the volume of gas inside these cylinders. There are extinguishing gas nozzles and flame detectors distributed as shown in the following table:
Flame detector | Heat detector | Nozzles | Number of cylinders | 
1 | 4 | 4 | 3 | Right combustion chamber
1 | 4 | 4 | 3 | Left combustion chamber
1 | 4 | 8 | 7 | Oil tank
Each of the flame and heat detectors has two independent lines, and for the fire system to operate a fire alarm signal must come from one of the fire detectors on the first line together with an alarm from one of the fire detectors on the second line. The weight-release solenoid then moves, the fire system operates, and at the same time the emergency trip signal goes from the limit switch to the various components of the unit so that they stop, and the slow-motion (turning gear) system operates. When the automatic fire extinguishing system operates, the cylinders are discharged, in which case they are replaced.
This document was prepared by Eng. Yousry Abdel Halim Abdel Latif, tested by Eng. Wasfy William Nashed – Senior Engineer, Occupational Safety and Health Department – and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed El-Lawandy, General Manager. It was reviewed by Chemist Ahmed El-Sayed Ibrahim and Eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman, General Manager of Quality Assurance and Quality Control, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anan – Head of Damietta Power Station Sector – and Eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa, Head of Quality Assurance and Quality Control Sector, East Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Open a work order | 
Wear personal protective equipment | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
 | Cylinder hoist | 
Spanner No. (28–30) | 
Adjustable spanner | 
Pliers | 
Procedure to be Carried Out
Place the cylinder on the cylinder holder at its installation position | 1.
Remove protective cover A and place it in a safe place until it is reused, taking care not to pull the safety pin of the cylinder valve | 2.
Connect suspension arms B to the cylinder head | 3
Place the cylinder hoist C under the cylinder and raise the cylinder until suspension arms B can be fixed to the weighing device D carrying the cylinder, making sure that the cylinder is installed in the correct valve-opening direction, as the cylinder valve has a specific opening direction | 4.
Remove the plug from the cylinder valve opening and fit the high-pressure hose E to the cylinder valve, taking care to fit a Klingerit gasket to ensure a tight connection | 5.
